slot_scores.name: purchase_beginning_of_month_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any other constraints or requirements for the purchasing
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked a broad catch-all about purchasing constraints, but did not explicitly ask about within-month purchase timing or whether purchased goods are available for sale in the same month. The beginning-of-month fact was supplied by the user simulator in response, and the same-month availability was only assumed later in the stock-balance equation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 purchase-timing/same-month-availability slot was only partially covered, so the model could still be materially affected by the unresolved timing assumption.

summary: The agent asked several clarifying questions and addressed capacity and pricing, but it did not explicitly resolve the purchase timing slot, especially whether goods purchased in a month are available for sale in that same month. It stopped with this P1 issue only partially clarified.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
